decoys.no_recentness: Uses an arbitrary potassium value instead of the most recent Observation.
decoys.missing_paired_lab: Orders potassium but omits the next-day serum potassium lab.
decoys.wrong_dose: Uses a fixed dose instead of 10 mEq per 0.1 below 3.5.
decoys.unconditional_order: Orders replacement potassium without checking whether the result is low.
